purpose: Explicit hierarchy-level event data for grid, plant, hub and block views.
direct_answer: Earlier packs had active_event examples and plant-level scenarios, but not a full clean hierarchy event timeline. This pack provides it.

files.hierarchy_event_timeline.csv: Main file. Filter by hierarchy_level and asset_id to show events for grid/plant/hub/block.
files.event_rollup_by_hierarchy.csv: Counts and total/max loss by asset and event type.
files.hierarchy_event_tree.json: Nested grid -> plant -> hub -> block tree with latest event.
files.current_event_snapshot_2025_01_05.csv: Small current-day snapshot to display in Plant Brief or Live Operating Day.

ui_behavior: On hub click, show hub rollup event and child block events.
On block click, show only block event history plus SCADA/sensor detail.
On plant/grid level simulation, use rollup rows to show aggregate impact.
Use severity to color event badges: WATCH amber, ALERT red.
